project.title: Customer Churn Prediction using Machine Learning
project.problemStatement: Built predictive model to forecast customer churn and reduce attrition.
project.dataUsed: Customer demographics and behavior data from CRM system.
project.methodsApplied: Data preprocessing and feature engineering with Python pandas; classification model using scikit-learn.
project.outcome: Achieved 85% accuracy, enabling targeted retention campaigns and reducing churn by 10%.
